## Panel

- **Rebuilt with React and shadcn/ui.**
  - The header fits on one row, with secondary actions in a menu on narrow screens.
  - The tabs and the search share a row.
  - Rows are compact.
  - Long names are cut with an ellipsis and a tooltip.
  - The full tunnel error appears in a banner.
  - Every feature from the previous panel is kept.
- **Spotlight-style search.** Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) or `/` to find open ports, ports detected on the server, closed ports, agent requests, servers, commands and activity.
  - Typing `3025` jumps to that port.
  - A port that is not open yet offers "Open port".
  - `>` lists only commands and `:` only ports.
  - A preview pane shows the details of the selected item.
  - ⌘↵ and → give quick actions.
  - Recent items come first.
- **Easier to read.**
  - Inter and JetBrains Mono are bundled with the panel.
  - Nothing is lighter than medium weight.
  - Nothing is smaller than 12px.
  - Secondary text has more contrast.
- **Softer dark mode.** Slate gray (#1e2024) instead of near-black, with off-white text.
- **New logo.** "Relay" shows the agent and the server linked through a tunnel ring.

## Development

- The panel source lives in `web/` (Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui).
- The built files are committed, so `go build` and `go install` still need no Node.
- CI rebuilds the panel and fails if the committed build drifts.
